name: École Polytechnique Master's (MSc&T) Excellence Scholarship — Ecole Polytechnique Foundation
duration: 2 years (M1 + M2); entry possible directly into M2
eligibleNationalities: Open to all nationalities — the Excellence Scholarship eligibility is 'All candidates admitted to one of our master program' with no nationality restriction; a Bangladeshi admitted to MSc&T qualifies. (The full-funding tracks on the same page — Lafayette/US, Singapore, Brazil/Trajetorias, Colombia/COLFUTURO — are nationality-restricted and exclude Bangladesh.)
languageRequirements: English required: IELTS Academic min 7.0 overall, or TOEFL iBT min 95 overall, or Cambridge CAE C1. Scores must be < 2 years old at the deadline. Test may be waived if English is your native language (passport/national ID required) or your last degree was entirely taught in English (with official attestation). May apply before sitting the test, but any offer is conditional on submitting scores. No level of French required for admission.
standardizedTests: No GRE/GMAT required for MSc&T admission (English test required as above).
minGPA: Not specified as a numeric threshold; 'high-level candidates' with a strong science/engineering background (M1: bachelor's of at least 3 years / 180 ECTS).
applicationFee: 90 EUR application processing fee (non-refundable). Separate 3,200 EUR non-refundable deposit on admission, later deducted from tuition.
fundingCovers: Partial tuition reduction (8,000 EUR/year deducted from tuition)
bondObligation: None for the Excellence Scholarship (return-home / service bonds apply only to the separate Singapore track).
renewalConditions: Paid out / continued upon successfully validating the first year of the Master.
benefits: 8,000 EUR per year, deducted from tuition fees (partial tuition reduction)
Paid upon successfully validating the first year of the Master
Awarded on academic excellence + diversity, decided after the selection interview
No separate scholarship application or extra documents — all admitted candidates are automatically considered
requiredDocuments: Contact details of 2 referees (recommendation letters required by the deadline)
English test results — IELTS / TOEFL iBT / Cambridge (uploaded; may be submitted later, offer conditional)
Degree certificate(s) / proof of academic qualifications
Passport or national ID (notably if claiming an English-test waiver)

timeline.deadline: 12 January 2026, noon Paris time (Round 2 — last round that qualifies for a scholarship; only Round 1 & 2 applicants can apply for a scholarship). Round 1: 13 October 2025. Later non-scholarship rounds: Round 3 = 9 March 2026, Round 4 = 22 April 2026.
timeline.resultsBy: Round 2 admission decisions mid-March 2026; scholarship results announced by email after admission and before the confirmation/payment deadline.
timeline.notes: Dates are the official September 2026 intake cycle as published on the deadlines page (crawled 2026-06-18; verified 2026-06-18 against source, after the 2026-06 anchor). Scholarship eligibility is gated to Rounds 1 and 2 only — apply early.

monthlyStipend: None (no living stipend — partial tuition reduction only)
postStudyWork: Not specified on this program page.
mustKnow: NOT fully funded: the Excellence Scholarship is a flat 8,000 EUR/year deducted from tuition (partial tuition reduction). No living stipend, airfare, insurance, or settlement allowance. MSc&T tuition is 15,400-28,950 EUR/year, so the student funds the tuition balance plus all living costs.

Scholarship-eligibility is gated to the application round: 'only students who apply in the first and second rounds of admissions can apply for a scholarship' — Round 2 deadline 12 Jan 2026. Applying in Rounds 3 or 4 forfeits scholarship consideration.
Two-step in effect: you must first be admitted to the MSc&T; admitted candidates are then automatically considered — there is no separate scholarship form and no extra documents.

Open to all nationalities (no exclusion of Bangladesh) — but the genuinely full-funding tracks on the same page (Lafayette/US, Singapore, Brazil, Colombia/COLFUTURO) ARE nationality-restricted and do NOT include Bangladesh.
An admission/selection interview is part of the process, and the scholarship decision follows that interview.
8,000 EUR is paid only after you successfully validate the first year of the Master.
Non-refundable costs regardless of scholarship: 90 EUR application fee and a 3,200 EUR deposit on admission (deposit later deducted from tuition).
English test required (IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 95 / Cambridge CAE C1); CROUS scholarships are not compatible with this degree and APL housing benefit is for French/European students only.
